Distribution and habitat data. The species is known only from Gyirong County in southern Xizang (Fig. 10 L). The specimen was collected by sifting leaf litter at altitudes of 2600 – 3000 m. Comparative notes. The new species is most similar to N. flexus Assing, 2014 in general appearance and aedeagus characters, but can be separated by the male sternite VII with truncate posterior margin (Fig. 8 A), and the broader apex of ventral process of aedeagus in ventral view (Fig. 8 C, D).
